name: Relay.app
description: Relay.app is a workflow automation platform that pairs 200+ app integrations with built-in AI steps and human-in-the-loop approvals. You build automations in a visual editor or by describing them in natural language, then add AI actions, custom code, and approval gates that pause a flow for a person before it acts. A genuine free tier ships with AI credits, with paid plans for more steps and team seats.

modelSupport.notes: Built-in AI steps run on leading LLMs (e.g. Claude, GPT).

edge: Combines deep app integrations with native AI steps and human-in-the-loop approval gates, so a workflow can pause for a person before acting.
cons: Step and AI-credit caps on lower tiers
